scope: Five exact normal-pace Solo seed-17 setups. Separate steering implementations, not independent players or repeated human observations. No pace copies count as additional evidence.

methods.visible: Shortest path on currently visible stationary-target board; conservative occupied tail; no future simulation, hidden RNG, retry, backtracking or fallback strategy.
methods.clearance: Visible-state weighted path: one cost per move plus two per adjacent wall, cable or boundary cell; replans each move, retains the tail, and never reads future state. Trades route length for current clearance; not guaranteed safer.
methods.general: Existing scored qualification search with simulated candidate moves, escape-space ranking and bounded backtracking. This remains solvability evidence, not human difficulty.

decision: Retain completion-only for all candidates. Separate algorithms are not automatically separate strategies; compare input journals explicitly. Neither route diversity nor algorithm agreement establishes a fair silver/gold margin, Team coordination cost or real-time execution difficulty.
